title: Heat spreader warm-up
line: A transient thermal FEA study of an aluminum heat spreader warming up after a 20 W component switches on.
description: Transient temperature of an aluminum heat spreader (100 x 100 x 10 mm) after a 20 W component on a 20 x 20 mm pad switches on. The other faces lose heat to 25 C air at 10 W/m^2/K. The study follows the plate for 6000 s, about six time constants, and returns the temperature history, the peak and the mean.
thumbnailAlt: Temperature of an aluminum heat spreader warming up from a 20 W pad, solved in RunMat
